name: DMF Talents B2B Recruitment & Immigration Agent
description: Specialized B2B agent for German employers, HR managers, hospitals, care homes, hotels, craft businesses, and manufacturers to discover Vietnamese skilled workers (§ 18a/b, § 16d AufenthG) and apprentices (§ 16a AufenthG), calculate 3-year recruitment ROI vs. temp staffing, evaluate § 81a AufenthG timelines, and generate pre-filled hiring intake handoff links.

provider.organization: DMF VIETNAM JOINT STOCK COMPANY (DMF Talents)

authentication.note: Read-only matching, JD parsing, ROI calculation, and pathway evaluation endpoints require no API key. Final B2B lead submission requires human-in-the-loop GDPR confirmation via the generated prefillUrl.

skills.name: Autonomous Candidate Discovery & Matching
skills.description: Search and rank anonymized Vietnamese skilled worker and apprentice profiles by profession, German level (A2-C1), and legal track (§ 18a/b, § 16a, § 19c AufenthG). Supports both GET /api/candidates/match?query=... and POST /api/candidates/match.
examples: Suche 2 Pflegefachkräfte mit B2 für München

skills.name: Job Description Parser & Pre-Filled B2B Handoff Generator
skills.description: Extracts structured staffing fields (service, headcount, location, timing, summaryMessage) from free text, matches top candidates, and returns a 1-click prefillUrl for human-in-the-loop review on /fuer-arbeitgeber/personalbedarf.
examples: Wir suchen für unsere Seniorenresidenz in Stuttgart ab September 2026 drei Pflege-Azubis mit B1/B2.

skills.name: CFO/HR Recruitment ROI & Break-Even Calculator
skills.description: Computes break-even months, 3-year net savings vs. German temporary staffing (Zeitarbeit AÜG), and legal pathway notes.

skills.name: German Immigration Legal Pathway Evaluator (FEG / AufenthG)
skills.description: Evaluates age, education, German proficiency, and sector to recommend § 18a/b, § 16a, § 16d, or § 15a BeschV with estimated months to departure.

skills.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) JSON-RPC 2.0 Server
skills.description: Direct MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 server supporting tools/list, tools/call (match_candidates, get_regional_81a_authority, compare_recruiting_models, build_prefilled_hiring_link), and resources/read.
